particle_epoch1.label: epoch_01
particle_epoch1.scene_selection: fixed first four of registered development panel
particle_epoch1.dots: all 64 foreground particle centers; radius indicates presence
particle_epoch1.boxes: LPWM glimpse extents, fixed initial top16 presence indices; not detected boxes

review_criteria: Use the same development panel PDMS/ADE/FDE trend, not repeated NAVTEST checkpoint selection
Assess future-repeat intervention;12 scenes are a limited diagnostic and not proof of correct forecasts
Check particle information/intent sensitivity and world retention; center movement alone is not a success or failure criterion
Flat development results and weak representation use across later3-5 epoch reviews would motivate redesign of this training formulation; no claim of model-family failure
uncertainty: Warmup does not guarantee later PDMS improvement and is not an established cause of the first-epoch score
Training loss windows contain different examples and do not isolate LPWM improvement from planner learning
Epoch3 is a first review point, not a convergence or saturation guarantee
